verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents a hosted MCP server whose inbox, message, thread and draft tools are open to any compatible client, plus skills for Claude Code and Codex. Labels, full-text search and drafts give an external agent tools to read, triage, draft and send. The caveat is that this works on AgentMail-hosted inboxes created for agents. Nothing shows it connecting to a user's existing mailbox, and no ChatGPT connection or hands-on test is documented. missing for 10: evidence of operating on the user's existing email account, a documented ChatGPT connection, independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end triage-to-send flow

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: AgentMail runs a hosted MCP server at https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, and attachment tools to any compatible client.
This includes OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other compatible tools.
so a LangGraph agent can send, reply, draft, label, and search email through a real inbox without any glue code.
Full-text search finds Threads by keyword across the sender, recipients, subject, and message body, ranked by relevance.
Human-in-the-Loop Review: An agent can create a `Draft` for a sensitive or important `Message`, which a human can then review and approve before it's sent.
